svg.title: One Avalonia application, desktop and browser hosts
svg.desc: The shared App, ScreeningRoom, Avalonia controls and XAML control templates run on desktop and in browser WebAssembly. VideoPlayer selects a backend. Browser HTMLMediaElement and WebGL are only the embedded video surface, while Avalonia draws the buttons and catalog. Desktop uses the FFmpeg engine and system audio APIs.
svg.text: ONE SHARED AVALONIA APPLICATION · TWO PLATFORM HOSTS
The same UI, theme and playback logic.
SHARED PROJECT · AvaVideoPlayer.Sample
App + ScreeningRoom + VideoPlayer (Avalonia UserControl)
Avalonia Grid · Button · Slider · ComboBox · Image catalog · same event handlers and commands
App.axaml + ScreeningRoomTheme.axaml: Avalonia control templates styled like the HTML reference
No separate browser UI implementation. Platform hosts only supply backend registration, media URLs and optional diagnostics.
VideoPlayer → IVideoBackend
Open · Play · Pause · Seek · Volume · Tracks · 360° camera
BROWSER HOST · .NET WEBASSEMBLY + AVALONIA
Same Avalonia controls → Avalonia UI canvas
BrowserVideoBackend → NativeControlHost video viewport
DESKTOP HOST · .NET + AVALONIA
Same Avalonia controls → desktop window
FFmpegVideoBackend → PlaybackEngine
Embedded media surface only
.NET / JS interop → avavideo.js → HTMLMediaElement
Browser codec decoding, seeking and sound output
Flat: video element · 360°: WebGL video texture
DevTools shows this native media host; the buttons are on the Avalonia canvas.
Native media engine
Clock + bounded queues → avavideo C ABI → FFmpeg
libavformat / libavcodec · swscale / swresample · libass
Video → Avalonia / Skia presenter · PCM → system audio
No HTML video element in the desktop playback path.
BROWSER DOM: TWO DIFFERENT CANVASES
Avalonia canvas
Buttons, sliders, selectors, catalog and text
Native media host: video + WebGL canvas
Only video pixels inside the player’s layout bounds
HTMLMediaElement is a decoder/output backend, not an HTML player UI.
DESKTOP SYSTEM AUDIO APIS
macOS · Core Audio / AudioToolbox
AudioQueueNewOutput · AudioQueueEnqueueBuffer
Windows · WASAPI
IAudioClient · IAudioRenderClient · IAudioClock
Linux · PulseAudio / ALSA · PipeWire Pulse compatibility
One public AvaVideoPlayer NuGet. The shared demo references it; owned library implementation stays in the private development repository.
Architecture shows implemented paths. Browser and desktop execution evidence are documented separately.
